label: 2. Bulk Insert (Recursive CTE)
sql:
-- Insert 100 records using recursive Common Table Expression
INSERT INTO users (username, email, balance)
WITH RECURSIVE generate_users(i) AS (
  SELECT 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i + 1 FROM generate_users WHERE i < 100
)
SELECT 
  'user_' || printf('%03d', i),
  'user_' || printf('%03d', i) || '@budsei.internal',
  round(abs(random() % 10000) / 100.0, 2)
FROM generate_users;

SELECT count(*), avg(balance) FROM users;
